record.name: Platform
record.purpose: The standards this group works to.

says: Alice founds a Team on her laptop, registers its knowledge source, commits two revisions, and records a permit for her desktop and then its revocation; the desktop is enrolled as her second device and imports packages from the laptop. Each bad package stops at the stage its record names and writes nothing else: a complete package whose body did not arrive (truncation) stops at received with body_missing; an incremental naming a baseline the desktop never committed stops at received with baseline_missing; a package addressed to another principal stops at received with audience_mismatch; a package carrying an executable hook stops at received with executable_import_refused; a package whose member path climbs out of the package is refused at admission with no result at all; a package whose body bytes were altered stops at controls_verified with object_digest_mismatch; a package carrying the newly issued revocation puts that revocation in force at controls_verified and stops there when its body is missing; and an older package still carrying the permit that revocation displaced then stops at received with control_superseded. What must not happen: any of them reaching verified or committed, a body written beside a failed check, or the revocation being dropped because the bodies failed.
